_comment: Production overrides. Every empty value below MUST be supplied at deploy time — the API fails fast at startup when Jwt:Key or ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection is missing or left at dev values. Prefer environment variables (double-underscore syntax): ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection, Jwt__Key, AllowedOrigins__0, Email__Host etc. See DEPLOYMENT.md at the repo root.
_comment_ConnectionStrings: Real SQL Server; 'localhost' is rejected in Production.
_comment_Jwt: Key must be a strong secret (256-bit+). Issuer/Audience inherit from appsettings.json unless overridden.
_comment_AllowedOrigins: Exact origins of the deployed SPA, e.g. https://app.enrollify.ph. Empty array falls back to the localhost dev origin — set at least AllowedOrigins__0.
_comment_Email: SMTP relay for notifications. Leave Enabled=false to run without email (sends are logged and skipped).
